proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P IPC registration/connect teardown flow (src/transport/p2p.cc), adding multi-segment export/import, segment-aware mapping, and deregistration cleanup for peer transport resources. Include memory because allocation/register/free semantics were changed for multi-segment ranges and ownership-safe deregistration (alloc/register helpers and register callbacks). Include network because proxy/UDS FD-transfer protocol and proxy-connection handle lifecycle were extended (batch FD query, tracked proxy handles, and cleanup paths) in shared proxy code.
